thread:
Riley O'Connor: hi all, starting next week and trying to grab the 'onboarding roadmap' and the 'first-week runbook' from Notion. i can see the workspace but those pages are missing from my sidebar. who owns them and how do i get edit rights? :wave:

Ivy Nguyen: welcome Riley! :tada: the onboarding roadmap lives under Company > People > Onboarding Roadmap. runbook is under Engineering > New Hires > First-week runbook. owners are listed at the top of each page (usually People Ops and eng-docs).

Riley O'Connor: owners show up as tags but i can't open the pages (403). i used SSO; email matches. any workaround?

Marco Ruiz: 403 usually means the page is restricted. two quick options: 1) file the docs-perms form (https://redwood.in/forms/docs-perms) with the page URLs and request "view" or "edit"; 2) ask an owner to add you manually. if you're in a rush, ping one of us with the page name.

Riley O'Connor: filing form now. also curious: can i duplicate the runbook to my private workspace to edit, or is duplication blocked?

Ivy Nguyen: short answer: duplication is allowed unless a page is explicitly set to "no duplicate" by the owner. best practice: duplicate into your Private pages and then move the copy to your Team space. small steps: ```Open page -> ... -> Duplicate -> Move -> Share -> Add editors```

docs-ops-bot: Ticket DOCS-4521 created for Riley O'Connor requesting view/edit on "Company Onboarding Roadmap" and "First-week runbook". Owner: People Ops. ETA: 1 business day.

Marco Ruiz: added you as viewer on the runbook (should appear in your sidebar under "Shared with me"). remember to duplicate before editing and change the title to include your initials.

Riley O'Connor: can see the runbook now, thanks! form submission confirmed. one last Q: where are the team templates for PR notes and handoff checklist?

Ivy Nguyen: PR notes and handoff checklist are in Engineering > Team Templates. owners = eng-docs. duplicate for your own use. if any template is locked, open a ticket to eng-docs and tag your manager.

Riley O'Connor: perfect, appreciate the quick help :pray:
